stories.summary: OpenAI published 722 mathematical manuscripts, grouped into 372 families of related results, in a public GitHub repository on Oct 6. The company says they were produced by an unreleased internal AI model given about 4,000 problems, at roughly 3 hours of ChatGPT Pro thinking compute per result. Many proofs ship with Lean formalizations so computers can check them, though not all do yet. It follows OpenAI's Sept 8 claim of solving the Navier-Stokes Millennium Prize problem, and mathematicians on X are fiercely debating verification and credit.
stories.title: OpenAI dumps 722 AI-generated math proofs, shaking up mathematics

stories.summary: Elon Musk confirmed in an X reply on Oct 4 that SpaceX will rename its AI unit from SpaceXAI to SpaceXSI, adopting 'super intelligence' terminology in line with Trump's push to replace 'artificial intelligence' in official language. No timeline given; the SpaceXAI accounts had not been renamed as of publication. The post drew wide discussion about the rebrand following SpaceX's combination with xAI.
stories.title: Musk says SpaceXAI will be renamed SpaceXSI in X reply

stories.summary: X launched X Lift, an AI-powered ad creation option unveiled at Advertising Week New York on Oct 6. Advertisers enter a business URL and X's AI generates a range of ad options including images and copy, and can build an entire campaign including targeting once a budget is set. X says the system is trained on X ads data and reported self-serve advertisers grew 50% in Q3 2026 vs Q3 2025.
stories.title: X launches AI-powered ad creation with X Lift

stories.summary: Chinese AI startup Moonshot AI has completed its final private funding round at about a $50B valuation and is preparing a Hong Kong IPO in Q1 2027, potentially raising up to $5B. The news broke on X via @wallstengine on Oct 6. Bank of America leads deal coordination with CICC, Deutsche Bank and Goldman Sachs as sponsors; Chinese data-security investigations into Moonshot and DeepSeek are reportedly underway.
stories.title: Moonshot AI eyes $5B Hong Kong IPO at $50B valuation
